The Daily Summit: a daily trivia game where rare answers win

The Daily Summit is a free daily trivia game at dailysummit.io. Each day has seven questions, like name a pizza topping, a road trip essential or a famous mountain. The rarer your answer, the more feet you climb: Common, Uncommon, Rare and Unicorn answers are worth more. Say one of the most common answers and a rockfall knocks you back to your last camp.

How to play The Daily Summit

You get 25 seconds per round and up to three safe answers, which pay times one, three and five. Set camp to bank your climb. The Final Push in round seven pays double. Climb through Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Apex and Mythic to the Sovereign rank at 2,500 feet, which unlocks a secret daily boss fight against the Storm Wraith.

Play today's daily climb, share your result with friends, or pick an unlimited route like food, animals, geography, sports, music, movies and slang.

Full rules & ranks
Climb
Every point is a foot of altitude. Rarer answers are worth more: 15, 30, 60 or 120.
Chain
Up to 3 safe answers a round, worth ×1, ×3, then ×5.
Rockfall
Name one of the most common answers and you lose the round's climb. Later rounds have more rockfalls: 1 in rounds 1-3, 2 in rounds 4-6, 3 in the Final Push.
Camp
Bank after any safe answer. A fall only drops you to your last camp. A full chain or the clock running out banks for you.
Final Push
Round 7 pays double.
Ranks
Bronze 0 · Silver 400 · Gold 650 · Platinum 1,000 · Diamond 1,500 · Apex 1,900 · Mythic 2,200 · Sovereign 2,500. Take the throne and a secret opens.
